title: Data and code for Day-to-Week Timing Reveals Cooler Spring Conditions and Concentrated Runoff Before Thermokarst Lake Drainage
description:
Derived datasets and selected analysis, processing, Google Earth Engine, and visualization scripts accompanying the manuscript on thermokarst lake drainage on St. Lawrence Island, Alaska. The archive includes lake and terrain attributes, candidate events and timing information, regional and matched hydroclimatic analysis inputs, and data and panels for the main figures.

The repository README documents the included materials, software dependencies, and limits on reproducing the full upstream workflows. Third-party source datasets remain subject to their providers' terms; this record's license applies to the authors' original contributions.
